result.instructions: Tools for Ayrshare, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Publish this announcement to LinkedIn and Facebook at 9:00 UTC tomorrow."; "Which of our posts from last week got the most impressions on Instagram?"; "Show the comments on our latest YouTube video post.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Ayrshare data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ayrshare_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ayrshare_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ayrshare_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ayrshare_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ayrshare_get_user
tools.title: Get profile details
tools.description: Get the profile this connection uses: linked social accounts, title, and the monthly post count and quota (monthlyPostCount, monthlyPostQuota).

tools.name: ayrshare_list_profiles
tools.title: List User Profiles
tools.description: List the User Profiles of the account (Business plan). Use a profile's profileKey as the Profile key to act for it.

tools.name: ayrshare_get_post
tools.title: Get post
tools.description: Get one post sent through Ayrshare by its Ayrshare Post ID, with per-network status.

id.description: Ayrshare Post ID, or the social network's own post ID when searchPlatformId is true.

tools.name: ayrshare_list_history
tools.title: List post history
tools.description: List posts sent through Ayrshare, newest first. Filter by date range, networks (OR logic), or status. Use lastDays for a quick window.

platforms.description: Return posts on any of these networks.

lastDays.description: Posts from the last N days.

status.description: Filter by post status, as the vendor reports it.

tools.name: ayrshare_get_history_post
tools.title: Get post history by ID
tools.description: Get the history of one post by its Ayrshare Post ID. Set searchAllPosts to also match posts made outside Ayrshare.

id.description: Ayrshare Post ID, or the social network's own post ID when searchPlatformId is true.

searchAllPosts.description: Also search posts not sent through Ayrshare.

tools.name: ayrshare_list_platform_history
tools.title: List history for one network
tools.description: List posts on one social network, including posts made outside Ayrshare. Page with the next cursor from the last reply.

since.description: Vendor date filter (start), as the vendor documents it.

until.description: Vendor date filter (end), as the vendor documents it.

tools.name: ayrshare_get_post_analytics
tools.title: Get post analytics
tools.description: Get real-time likes, impressions, views, and reactions for one Ayrshare post, per network.

id.description: Ayrshare Post ID, or the social network's own post ID when searchPlatformId is true.

platforms.description: Limit the reply to these networks.

startDate.description: Start of the daily range (vendor format).

endDate.description: End of the daily range (vendor format).

tools.name: ayrshare_get_social_analytics
tools.title: Get social account analytics
tools.description: Get follower and engagement analytics for the linked social accounts on the chosen networks.

tools.name: ayrshare_list_comments
tools.title: List comments on a post
tools.description: List comments on a post by Ayrshare Post ID (or the network's post ID with searchPlatformId true).

id.description: Ayrshare Post ID, or the social network's own post ID when searchPlatformId is true.

platform.description: The network the post is on.

searchPlatformId.description: Treat id as the network's own post ID.

tools.name: ayrshare_create_post
tools.title: Publish or schedule a post
tools.description: PUBLISHES to the chosen social accounts now, or schedules it when scheduleDate is set (UTC). Not undoable from here: use ayrshare_delete_post to remove it. Pass idempotencyKey so a repeated call is rejected as a duplicate instead of posting twice.

post.description: Post text. May be an empty string for a media-only post.

mediaUrls.description: Public https image or video URLs.

scheduleDate.description: Schedule the post at this UTC time instead of publishing now.

shortenLinks.description: Shorten links in the post text.

idempotencyKey.description: Your unique ID for this post. A repeated ID is rejected.

tools.name: ayrshare_delete_post
tools.title: Delete a post
tools.description: DELETES a post sent through Ayrshare from its social networks by Ayrshare Post ID. Deleted posts cannot be restored.

id.description: Ayrshare Post ID, or the social network's own post ID when searchPlatformId is true.

tools.name: ayrshare_post_comment
tools.title: Comment on a post
tools.description: Adds a PUBLIC comment on a post on the chosen networks, as the linked account.

id.description: Ayrshare Post ID, or the social network's own post ID when searchPlatformId is true.

searchPlatformId.description: Treat id as the network's own post ID.

tools.name: ayrshare_delete_comment
tools.title: Delete a comment
tools.description: DELETES one comment by its Ayrshare Comment ID (or the network's comment ID with searchPlatformId true).

id.description: Ayrshare Comment ID, or the network's comment ID.

platform.description: The network the comment is on.

searchPlatformId.description: Treat id as the network's own comment ID.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Ayrshare
prompts.description: What you can do with Ayrshare here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_the_results_of_recent_posts
prompts.title: Check the results of recent posts
prompts.description: List the post history of the last days, then read one post with its status per network. Read its likes, impressions and views.

prompts.name: check_the_monthly_post_count_and_quota
prompts.title: Check the monthly post count and quota
prompts.description: Read the profile this connection uses, with its linked accounts and its monthly post count and quota. List the User Profiles of the account.

prompts.name: review_follower_and_engagement_analytics
prompts.title: Review follower and engagement analytics
prompts.description: Read follower and engagement analytics for the linked social accounts on the networks you choose.

prompts.name: read_the_comments_on_a_post
prompts.title: Read the comments on a post
prompts.description: List the comments on one post by its Ayrshare Post ID, or by the network's own post ID.

prompts.name: publish_or_schedule_a_post
prompts.title: Publish or schedule a post
prompts.description: Publish a post now to the chosen accounts, or schedule it with a UTC date. Pass an idempotency key so a repeated call is rejected instead of posting twice.

prompts.name: remove_a_post_or_a_comment
prompts.title: Remove a post or a comment
prompts.description: Delete a post from its social networks, or delete one comment. Deleted posts cannot be restored.
